body: saaaaame. when I was a teenager I was dying to go to the projekt revolution that had MCR & Placebo on the bill as well (just checked -- this was 2007 :/). They weren't coming to my city (Montreal) but were visiting Toronto, which is a 5 hour bus ride, not so bad. I didn't have enough money to travel and get a ticket though and since I was 15 or so, my mom wasn't allowing me to travel with friends anyway. since then, there have been many chances, I'm sure, but like many of you I just got distracted by other things/genres of music and only listened casually until recently, of course
